title: Bounded derived-complete complexes with finitely generated cohomology
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subset A$ an ideal, and $D(A)$ the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of $A$-modules, with cohomology modules $H^i(K)$. Define

$$
 D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(A,I)\subset D(A)
$$

to be the full subcategory of the objects $K$ such that $H^i(K)=0$ for all but finitely many $i$, every $H^i(K)$ is a finitely generated $A$-module, and $K$ is derived complete with respect to $I$ [def-weil-point-derived-complete-module-complex]. For a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], write $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E)=D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E,(\varpi_E))$.

source.place: the definition of $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E)$ in the statement
